scope.note: a collision-only decision document, not a lap layout: no gate mesh, no race director, no lap timing, no car simulated

bar.source: probes/map-laps loop-01 (usa_amboy) acceptance: the same collision-only search, enclosed islands, clearance erosion, exact triangles, engine trace and draw coverage

criteria.rule: the loop lies in the component the measured point-to-point path uses (the spawn component)
the enclosed island survives >= 3 clearance erosions (>= 2.0 m ring lower bound)

course.conclusion: the course component has no enclosed island >= 100 m2 (largest 2.25 m2), so the same island-based search cannot extract a closed loop on the course

decision.rule: a loop is a lap only if it meets every bar criterion; the decisive topology test is that it lies in the component the measured point-to-point path uses
decision.reason: the course component 171 has no enclosed island >= 100 m2 (largest 2.25 m2); the three extracted loops are all in other components and unreachable from the committed spawn; the nearest (loop-01) is 1.581139 m away across a ramp whose raster neighbour dh is 5.179 cm per 0.5 m cell (limit 2.5 cm) and whose exact grade is 6.18 % average / 9.76 % over 0.5 m (limit 5 %); loop-02 and loop-03 are 420.8102 m and 315.0127 m away and 0.000 / 0.209 drawn
